fixtures.origin: Synthetic GeoPackage containers written by GDAL 3.13.3 (ogr2ogr, gdal_translate) on 2026-09-20 from the literal GeoJSON/CSV sources in `spec/build_fixtures.py` (adapter-expansion phase 2), and the parsed twin of each written by `synapse_cdm.adapters.geopackage.parse_payload`. Every name is prefixed EXERCISE, no coordinate describes a real feature, the one raster table is a 2x2 constant image, and no file derives from any recorded dataset; hashes, the exact GDAL commands and GDAL's own reading of every layer are in `spec/geopackage_pin.json` and `independent/`, and the assertion is a tracked test's: `tests/test_cdm_geopackage_adapter.py::test_every_fixture_is_synthetic_by_default`.
